    @pytest.mark.parametrize("days_until_payment_due", [-1])
    @pytest.mark.priority(3)
    @pytest.mark.description("Test case for a successful validation for a user who is blocked from features when programEnd_date is breached as the user's program has plans assigned.")
    def test_appAccess_block(self,days_until_payment_due):
        allure.dynamic.title(
        f"Given a user's program has plans assigned, "
        f"When the programEnd_date is breached (days_until_payment_due={days_until_payment_due}), "
        f"Then the user should be blocked from accessing features"
    )
        try:
            self.delete_test_customer_and_subscription()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Nothing to delete! so you can proceed with other tests {e}")
        paywalUtils.set_login_token(self,'webStripeUsername', 'webStripeUserPassword')
        #validate plans are assigned
        programs = self.mongo_database.get_collection("programs")
        program = programs.find_one({"name": self.programName2})
        assert program is not None, "program not found in MongoDB"
        program.get("payment_plans")!= None, "Program should have any payment plans assigned"
    
        userInputtingDppdate = paywalUtils.get_dpp_date_for_days_left(self,days_until_payment_due)
        program_endDate = paywalUtils.UserprogramEndDateLogic_setUp(self,userInputtingDppdate, USER_ID=self.USER_ID,cohortId=self.cohort_Id, tokenType=updateUserCohortProgDate.csrf_token, cookieType=updateUserCohortProgDate.cookie, payloadType=updateUserCohortProgDate.payload,is_user_update=False)
    
        fetched_user_data = paywalUtils.fetch_userSubscriptionData(self)
        assert fetched_user_data is not None, "Fetched user data is empty"
        program_endDate = program_endDate.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        print(f"Program end date: {program_endDate}")
    
        assert fetched_user_data["subscription_info"]["payment_due_date"] == program_endDate, \
            f"Payment due date mismatch. Expected: {program_endDate}, Got: {fetched_user_data['subscription_info']['payment_due_date']}"
        assert fetched_user_data["subscription_info"]["days_until_payment_due"] == days_until_payment_due, \
            f"Days until payment due mismatch. Expected: {days_until_payment_due}, Got: {fetched_user_data['subscription_info']['days_until_payment_due']}"
        assert fetched_user_data["subscription_info"]["has_access_to_app"] is False, "User should have access to the app"
        assert fetched_user_data["subscription_info"]["can_subscribe_now"] is True, "User should be able to subscribe now"
        assert fetched_user_data["subscription_info"]["is_subscribed"] is False, "User should not have any subscription entry in the database"
        assert fetched_user_data["app_access"]["access"] is False, "User should have access to the app features"
    
        #validate "error": "Subscription required to access this resource."
        headers = {
            "Authorization": "Token token=" + config.get_auth_token(),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        url = f"{self.base_url}/api/v1/exercises"
        request_payload = load_request_payload("WebApp/createExerciseData.json")
        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers,data=json.dumps(request_payload))
        assert response.status_code == 403, f"Expected 403 Forbidden, got {response.status_code}"
        response_data = response.json()
        print(f"Response data: {response_data}")
        assert "error" in response_data, "Response should contain an 'error' key"
        assert response_data["error"] == "Subscription required to access this resource.", \
            f"Expected error message 'Subscription required to access this resource.', got {response_data['error']}"
        # validate the app access block from UI
        _, auth_token = self.createSession(config.get_login_credentials()['webStripeUsername'], config.get_login_credentials()['webStripeUserPassword'])
        assert auth_token is not None, "Failed to create session"
        print("Auth token received:", auth_token)
        chrome_options = Options()
        chrome_options.add_argument("--headless")
        chrome_options.add_argument("--window-size=1920,1080")
        self.__class__.driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=chrome_options)
        self.driver = self.__class__.driver
        self.driver.set_window_size(1920, 1080)
        self.driver.get("https://app-develop.habitnu.com/")
        self.driver.execute_script("localStorage.setItem(arguments[0], arguments[1]);", "token", auth_token)
        self.driver.refresh()
        self.driver.get(f"https://app-develop.habitnu.com/app/dashboard")
        self.driver.maximize_window()
        wait = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10)
        try:
            self.driver.find_element("xpath", "//a[text()='Accept']").click()
        except Exception:
            pass
        wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable(("xpath", "//p[text()='Your program ended!']")))
        wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable(("xpath", "//span[text()='Meals']")))
        self.driver.find_element("xpath", "//span[text()='Meals']").click()
